children: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) on Wednesday raised its 2026 South Korea economic growth projection to 3.2% from 2.6% projected in July, due to strong exports and corporate earnings, supported by the artificial intelligence boom.

However, the agency warned of potential risks, including rising geopolitical tensions, increased volatility in global financial markets, and additional US tariff hikes, which could affect exports and investment.
The ADB also revised up its 2027 growth outlook by 0.3 percentage point to 2.3%.
The ADB added that expansionary fiscal policy and robust corporate earnings are contributing to a gradual recovery in private consumption.
On the inflation side, the ADB maintained its forecasts at 2.7% in 2026 and 2.2% in 2027.
Previously, the Ministry of Finance and Economy revised up South Korea's GDP growth forecast by 1 percentage point to 3% in its second-half policy report.

title: ADB Raises South Korea's 2026 GDP Growth Forecast to 3.2%
